description:
Retrieve the complete size guide chart, body measurement matrix (Chest/Bust, Waist, Hip, Length, Shoulders), unit switcher (inches/cm), how-to-measure guidelines, and automatic best-fit size recommendations for a specific product handle.

PURPOSE & DISAMBIGUATION:
- Dedicated size guide and fit consultancy tool for apparel and footwear.
- Computes dimensional measurements across sizes, supports metric (cm) <-> imperial (in) unit conversions, and maps international/brand scales.
- If user body measurements are provided (e.g. chest: 40 in, waist: 32 in), computes the best matching size variant with fit confidence and relaxed vs snug fit advice.
- Distinct from 'products.items.check_stock': Use 'products.items.get_size_guide' when the user asks sizing/fit questions (e.g. 'What size fits a 40 chest?' or 'Show me the size chart'); use 'products.items.check_stock' for inventory checking.

WHEN TO USE:
- When a user asks about sizing, fit, measurements, or how a garment fits (e.g., 'Is M true to size?', 'What are the chest measurements for this shirt in cm?').
- When helping a customer choose between two sizes based on their body dimensions.
- When rendering a full size chart matrix.

WHEN NOT TO USE:
- Do NOT use for products without size variants (e.g., standard accessories, bags).

BEHAVIOR & SAFETY:
- Read-only and idempotent.
- Supports 'in' (inches) and 'cm' (centimeters) with automated dynamic range conversion.
- Connects each recommended size to its direct 1-click checkout permalink (https://s.polopan.com/p/{handle}/{size_index}).

PARAMETERS & CONSTRAINTS:
- 'handle' (string, required): Unique product handle identifier.
- 'unit' (enum 'in' | 'cm', default 'in'): Preferred measurement unit system.
- 'desired_size' (string, optional): Specific size variant to inspect (e.g. 'M', 'L', '32', '40').
- 'user_chest' (number, optional): User's chest / bust body measurement.
- 'user_waist' (number, optional): User's waist body measurement.
- 'user_hip' (number, optional): User's hip body measurement.
- 'user_unit' (enum 'in' | 'cm', default 'in'): Unit of the user's provided body measurements.

desired_size.description: Optional specific size label to highlight or verify (e.g. 'M', 'L', 'XL', '32')

unit.description: Measurement unit system for the size chart ('in' for inches, 'cm' for centimeters)

user_chest.description: Optional user body chest/bust measurement for automated fit recommendation

user_hip.description: Optional user body hip measurement for automated fit recommendation

user_unit.description: Unit for the user's input measurements ('in' or 'cm')

user_waist.description: Optional user body waist measurement for automated fit recommendation

name: products.items.get_size_guide
title: Get Product Size Guide & Fit Recommendation
